tagline: Self-hosted caregiver coordination: your data stays with you.

fields.usernameHint: Your first and last name without spaces, for example JaneSmith. Upper and lower case do not matter.

invite.invalid: Invalid or expired invitation. Ask the person who invited you for a new link.
invite.usernameHint: You will sign in with this name from now on. Now just choose your password.

forgot.subtitle: Forgot password
forgot.askAdmin: Your administrator creates a reset link for you and passes it on. Open the link and choose a new password. The link is valid for 24 hours and can only be used once.

reset.subtitle: New password
reset.tooShort: The password must be at least {{count}} characters long.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.done: You can now sign in with your new password. Other open sessions have been signed out.
reset.invalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Links are valid for 24 hours and can only be used once. Ask your administrator for a new link.
reset.doneNamed: You can now sign in with your username {{username}} and your new password. Other open sessions have been signed out.

first.intro: You are setting up this server. Your account becomes the administrator. Your username is your first and last name without spaces, for example JaneSmith.
